test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.**

The melody has been composed wonderfully by Kayra.

options.text: Kayra has been composing the melody wonderfully.
Kayra has composed the melody wonderfully.
Kayra had composed the melody wonderfully.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Kayra has composed the melody wonderfully. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In passive voice, the melody is the receiver of the action.
 
• In active voice, we make the doer of the action (Kayra) the subject.
 
 
• **Passive Structure**: Subject + "to be" verb + past participle+ "by" + optional adverb__
 
• **Active Structure**: __Subject + active verb + object + optional adverb__
 
 
 
• So, "**The melody**" becomes the object in the active sentence, and "**Kayra**" becomes the subject.
 
• The passive verb "**has been composed**" is transformed into the active form "**has composed**." 
 
• The adverb "**wonderfully**" remains in the same position in the active sentence to maintain the intended meaning.
 
• So, the transformed active sentence is: "*Kayra has composed the melody wonderfully.*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
